d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar desh ke vibhinn hisson men kam karne vale bihar ke log ab apne ghar laut rahe hain, lekin trenon men bethasha bhir ke karan unki yatra behad kashtadayi ho gaee hai. bihar aane vali lagbhag sabhi pramukh aur speshal trenon men pair rakhne tak ki jagah nahin bachi hai, jisse yatriyon ki mushkilen kaphi barh gaee hain.
Darvaje aur pharsh par baithkar saphar karne ko majbur yatri
